correctness.rationale: Two-stage order-three Radau IIA has rational stability map R(z)=(6+2z)/(6-4z+z²). For Q_n=S_n-I, denominator invertible on CTMC spectrum and R(hQ_n) has row sums 1. Taylor R(z)=1+z+z²/2+z³/6+z⁴/36-z⁵/108+O(z^6); for n<=5 any generator reachable off-diagonal minimal path length <=4 yields local positivity, whereas n>=6 directed cycles have length-5 target with negative leading coefficient. Exact modular inversion modulo S^n=1 of the rational matrix coefficients, supported by explicit all-polynomial certificates for n2..6, shows all entries strictly positive n2..5 for all h>0. n6 only exceptional coefficient is h^5 q(h) where q=h^5+15h^4+60h^3+90h²+36h−12, with strictly positive q derivative, unique root rho~0.208608859735; other coefficient numerators and denominator positive, including diagonal via two interval arguments. At h0 the identity is nonnegative. Fourier diagonalization yields positive rank-one limit at large h for any n. Fresh independent rational matrix evaluations for n2..6 and Taylor/root checks agreed; source SymPy modular inversion code checks full identities, not simply sampled logs.
